name: Embodiment (Conduit Force of Nature)
body:
Embodiment abilities are about changing your form to those related to your force of nature.

Embodiment (Sp)

You gain the ability to change your form to one tied to your force of nature. You can expend 2 primal points to cast beast shape I as a spell-like ability with the following caveats based on your force of nature:

Fauna – none
Flames – hot-climate creatures only
Land – land creatures only
Ocean – aquatic creatures only
Rime – cold-climate creatures only
Sky – flying creatures only
Verdant – you take on the form of a small or medium plant creature instead of an animal.

You can expend a third primal point to increase the duration of the spell-like ability to 1 hour per class level.

Embodiment, Improved (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): embodiment primal ability

When using the embodiment primal ability, the spell-like ability is increased to beast shape II, with the same restrictions as before, or elemental body I with the following caveats (or substitutions in addition to the beast shape):

Fauna – vermin shape I
Flames – fire elementals only
Land – earth elementals only
Ocean – water elementals only
Rime – ice elemental (+2 Constitution and +4 natural armor. Darkvision 60 feet, resist cold 20, vulnerability to fire, and the numbing cold ability)
Sky – air elementals only
Verdant – fey form I
Embodiment, Greater (Su)

Prerequisite(s): improved embodiment primal ability

Your ability to empower your body with primal energy has peaked. When using the embodiment primal ability, the spell-like ability is increased to beast shape III with the same restrictions as before, or elemental body II with the following caveats (or optional substitutions in addition to the beast shape):

Fauna – vermin shape II
Flames – fire elementals only
Land – earth elementals only
Ocean – water elementals only
Rime – ice elemental (+4 Constitution and +5 natural armor. Darkvision 60 feet, resist cold 20, vulnerability to fire, and the numbing cold ability)
Sky – air elementals only
Verdant – plant shape I
Embodiment, Major (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): greater embodiment primal ability

Your ability to empower your body with primal energy has peaked. When using the embodiment primal ability, the spell-like ability is increased to beast shape IV with the same restrictions as before, or elemental body III with the following caveats (or optional substitutions in addition to the beast shape):

Fauna – no additional options
Flames – fire elementals only
Land – earth elementals only
Ocean – water elementals only
Rime – ice elemental (+6 Constitution, +2 Strength, -2 Dexterity and +6 natural armor.
Darkvision 60 feet, resist cold 20, vulnerability to fire, and the numbing cold ability)
Sky – air elementals only
Verdant – plant shape II
Embodiment, Grand (Sp)

Prerequisite(s): major embodiment primal ability

Your ability to empower your body with primal energy has peaked. When using the embodiment primal ability, the spell-like ability is increased to elemental body IV with the following caveats (or optional substitutions in addition to the previous options):

Fauna – magical beast shape
Flames – fire elementals only
Land – earth elementals only
Ocean – water elementals only
Rime – ice elemental (+8 Constitution, +4 Strength, -2 Dexterity and +6 natural armor.
Darkvision 60 feet, resist cold 20, vulnerability to fire, icewalking, and the numbing cold ability)
Sky – air elementals only
Verdant – plant shape III
